item.title: Virginia Contractor License: 15 Questions People Ask, Answered
item.description: Virginia licenses contractors in Class A, B and C by job size through DPOR. Here are straight answers to the 15 questions people search most, from cost and timing to reciprocity and renewals. Each answer is short, plain and checked against the official board and exam sources.
